verses.ar: شَجَوِيَّةٌ لِدَاوُدَ، غَنَّاهَا لِلرَّبِّ بِسَبَبِ كَلَامِ كُوشَ ٱلْبِنْيَامِينِيِّ يَارَبُّ إِلَهِي، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ. خَلِّصْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَطْرُدُونَنِي وَنَجِّنِي،
verses.kjv: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite. O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.web: A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا يَفْتَرِسَ كَأَسَدٍ نَفْسِي هَاشِمًا إِيَّاهَا وَلَا مُنْقِذَ.
verses.kjv: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending [it] in pieces, while [there is] none to deliver.
verses.web: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ إِلَهِي، إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ هَذَا. إِنْ وُجِدَ ظُلْمٌ فِي يَدَيَّ.
verses.kjv: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.web: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

verses.ar: إِنْ كَافَأْتُ مُسَالِمِي شَرًّا، وَسَلَبْتُ مُضَايِقِي بِلَا سَبَبٍ،
verses.kjv: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.web: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

verses.ar: فَلْيُطَارِدْ عَدُوٌّ نَفْسِي وَلْيُدْرِكْهَا، وَلْيَدُسْ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيَاتِي، وَلْيَحُطَّ إِلَى ٱلتُّرَابِ مَجْدِي. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take [it;] yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.web: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

verses.ar: قُمْ يَارَبُّ بِغَضَبِكَ. ٱرْتَفِعْ عَلَى سَخَطِ مُضَايِقِيَّ وَٱنْتَبِهْ لِي. بِٱلْحَقِّ أَوْصَيْتَ.
verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me [to] the judgment [that] thou hast commanded.
verses.web: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

verses.ar: وَمَجْمَعُ ٱلْقَبَائِلِ يُحِيطُ بِكَ، فَعُدْ فَوْقَهَا إِلَى ٱلْعُلَى.
verses.kjv: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.web: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَدِينُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ. ٱقْضِ لِي يَارَبُّ كَحَقِّي وَمِثْلَ كَمَالِي ٱلَّذِي فِيَّ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity [that is] in me.
verses.web: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

verses.ar: لِيَنْتَهِ شَرُّ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ وَثَبِّتِ ٱلصِّدِّيقَ. فَإِنَّ فَاحِصَ ٱلْقُلُوبِ وَٱلْكُلَى ٱللهُ ٱلْبَارُّ.
verses.kjv: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.web: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

verses.ar: تُرْسِي عِنْدَ ٱللهِ مُخَلِّصِ مُسْتَقِيمِي ٱلْقُلُوبِ.
verses.kjv: My defence [is] of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.web: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

verses.ar: ٱللهُ قَاضٍ عَادِلٌ، وَإِلَهٌ يَسْخَطُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ.
verses.kjv: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry [with the wicked] every day.
verses.web: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

verses.ar: إِنْ لَمْ يَرْجِعْ يُحَدِّدْ سَيْفَهُ. مَدَّ قَوْسَهُ وَهَيَّأَهَا،
verses.kjv: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.web: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

verses.ar: وَسَدَّدَ نَحوَهُ آلةَ ٱلْمَوْتِ. يَجْعَلُ سِهَامَهُ مُلْتَهِبَةً.
verses.kjv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.web: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

verses.ar: هُوَذَا يَمْخَضُ بِٱلْإِثْمِ. حَمَلَ تَعَبًا وَوَلَدَ كَذِبًا.
verses.kjv: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.web: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

verses.ar: كَرَا جُبًّا. حَفَرَهُ، فَسَقَطَ فِي ٱلْهُوَّةِ ٱلَّتِي صَنَعَ.
verses.kjv: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch [which] he made.
verses.web: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

verses.ar: يَرْجِعُ تَعَبُهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَعَلَى هَامَتِهِ يَهْبِطُ ظُلْمُهُ.
verses.kjv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.web: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُ ٱلرَّبَّ حَسَبَ بِرِّهِ، وَأُرَنِّمُ لِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلْعَلِيِّ.
verses.kjv: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
verses.web: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
